content_fixes.old: God didn't choose us to get roasted; He chose us for a life-changing moment through our main man, Jesus. He took one for the team, and his death was the ultimate victory for us. So, whether we're alive and kicking or six feet under, we're alive *with him*! So, keep hyping each other up. Build that hope so everyone's on the same page, no one gets left behind. I know you're already doing it, so just keep that good energy flowing.
